name: @nathapp/nestjs-docs-mcp

tools.name: find_package
tools.description: Find which @nathapp package(s) cover a capability need. Pass a short need phrase such as 'multi-tenant request isolation' or 'send SMS'. Returns ranked catalog entries with packages, references, and a next: "get_usage" pointer to read the usage guide.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Read the whole usage reference for one nathapp package. Pass either form: 'nestjs-tenant' or '@nathapp/nestjs-tenant'. Returns the complete reference file (never truncated) and, for multi-reference packages, a trailing "See also" block naming the other references with their need lines.

tools.name: get_example
tools.description: Read the example code for one nathapp package. Pass either form: 'nestjs-tenant' or '@nathapp/nestjs-tenant'. Returns every file under examples/<short-name>/ verbatim, each headed by its path, in sorted order.

tools.name: get_api
tools.description: List the exported API surface (names + one-line signatures) of one nathapp package. Pass either form: 'nestjs-tenant' or '@nathapp/nestjs-tenant'. Optionally pass "from" (a directory path) to resolve the package from a specific workspace member. Prefers the installed package resolved via workspace roots; falls back to the bundled docs snapshot when not installed. Returns JSON: { package, version, source: "installed"|"snapshot", exports: [{ name, signature }], truncated? }. Exports are capped at 200.

instructions: Docs for the @nathapp/nestjs-* packages. Serves the same reference content as the nathapp-nestjs-patterns skill, for agents that cannot load skills. Before writing code that imports @nathapp/nestjs-*, call find_package with the capability you need, then get_usage and get_example for the matched package, then get_api to confirm the exports of the installed version.
